limits.output_integer_policy: Every normalized numerator/denominator in computed, including denominator_value and angle differences, must fit40 digits. Otherwise unknown/resource_limit with computed=null; intermediate4096-bit limit alone does not imply representable output.

semantic_handoff_guards.requirement: families means union of independently parameterized families in the same variable. It never means an intersection or a shared integer index. Establish the logical operator from active evidence; unresolved AND/OR produces unknown/unresolved_premise before mathematics.
semantic_handoff_guards.counterexample: 2πZ∩3πZ=6πZ, while union on[0,6π]={0,2π,3π,4π,6π}. A correct union calculation cannot certify the intersection.

semantic_handoff_guards.requirement: All angles, interval endpoints and claimed roots must denote the same real variable. For θ=ax+b, first establish the transformation and complete inverse mapping as separate supported facts; preserve real values, turns and endpoint flags. Unsupported mapping is unknown, not an implicit division or angle rename.
semantic_handoff_guards.counterexample: θ=2x needs θ∈[0,4π] for x∈[0,2π]; two residuesθ are not two x-roots. Mod2π equality cannot deduplicate0 and4π as real roots.

semantic_handoff_guards.requirement: Assembler establishes one coordinate variable and domain for every set/point; sets from x and t require a supported preimage/image mapping. The v1.0 payload contains no variable tag for generic sets, so typed schema alone cannot certify this condition. Bind to existing M01 interpretations/facts/assumptions and reject unresolved mapping.
semantic_handoff_guards.counterexample: t=4 with t=2^x maps to x=2; intersecting t≥4 with x≤3 as sets of numbers silently changes the problem.

semantic_handoff_guards.requirement: No current operation proves logarithmic rationalization, constant signs, a substitution preimage, or the complete original domain. Preserve sign equivalence as an explicitly scoped other fact (M01 has no sign_equivalence enum), with the compared expressions, domain and justification. Use equivalence only for a separately established inequality solution-set equivalence on that domain; never identity.
semantic_handoff_guards.counterexample: Atx4 log₂x=2≠3=x−1; replacing this summand in log₂x−5/2≥0 reverses truth. Denominator of a rationalized expression cannot certify original logarithmic domain.

semantic_handoff_guards.requirement: A singleton symmetric difference or a denominator fact does not select the rubric. Classify original admissibility, cause and all other requirements in M03; retain unknown independently of ready unrelated facts.
semantic_handoff_guards.counterexample: Lost admissible−1 and included forbidden1 can both be singleton differences but have different mathematical causes; incomplete source scan cannot assign either score.

semantic_handoff_guards.requirement: Exact facts depend on verified problem inputs, not on source prestige. Quarantine selfprep2026 p75 example2; do not copy unsupported author grades, unavailable Ilyich scans or navigation-only videos into verified rule premises.
semantic_handoff_guards.counterexample: Printed selfprep answer includesx1, whereas printed original evaluates3/4>0 under≤0.
